Chooses what is read where the horizontal texture coordinate (u) is not between 0 and 1. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.

| Mode | Result |
|---|---|
| 0 | Repeat: the texture starts again, the default. |
| 1 | Mirror: every second repeat is turned around. |
| 2 | Clamp: the edge texel is stretched out. |
| 3 | Border: the color of [SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor), opaque black by default. |

[SetSamplerAddressModeV](SetSamplerAddressModeV) does the same for the vertical coordinate (v), and [SetSamplerAddressModeW](SetSamplerAddressModeW) for the depth coordinate (w), which flat textures do not use.
@param sampler  The sampler to change.
@param mode     The address mode from the table above.
@gap The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error. Mirror once (the coordinate is mirrored and then clamped) is not offered, since not every graphics card can do it.
